description:
Fair Deal Property Your Trusted Experts for Residential Sales

Are delighted to present for sale No. 17 Sandyview Drive, a substantial five-bedroom semi-detached residence, ideally located in Riverside, just off the Tuam Road and within a few minutes’ walk of Galway city centre.

Extending to over 1,600 square feet, this impressive property has been completely refurbished within the past 12 months. Beautifully considered interiors, contemporary fixtures and fine finishes create a wonderful sense of light, space and luxury throughout. An adjoining self-contained studio apartment adds further appeal, offering excellent potential for additional rental income.

Importantly, the refurbishment has extended beyond the cosmetic, with a brand-new condensing boiler and heating controls installed, the electrical system upgraded, and the windows resealed, further enhancing the comfort, efficiency and overall standard of the property.

On arrival, an energy-efficient composite front door opens into a bright and spacious entrance hallway. Contemporary white oak flooring and a freshly painted white stairwell set the tone for the beautifully finished accommodation beyond.

The main living room is particularly impressive, with generous proportions and an oversized window that fills the interior with natural light. A newly fitted stove, framed by artisan tiles, provides an attractive focal point, bringing warmth and character to this elegant space.

To the rear, the completely remodelled kitchen features contemporary fittings, built-in appliances and lovely views over the garden. From here, the accommodation flows into a second lounge, where an elevated outlook makes the most of the garden views and provides a welcoming setting for relaxation.

A large utility room offers further practical space. Fully plumbed and tiled from floor to ceiling, it also provides scope to accommodate an additional bathroom suite.

Upstairs, four beautifully appointed bedrooms continue the home’s impressive standard of finish. The exceptionally spacious main bedroom features a super-wide window, generous floor space and built-in wardrobes. Two further double bedrooms, positioned to the front and rear, offer comfortable accommodation, while the single bedroom overlooks the garden and has space for a desk.

The adjoining self-contained studio/granny flat is a valuable addition to the property and has also been substantially upgraded. The kitchen has been completely refurbished and is fitted with new white goods, while the accommodation benefits from a new shower and hot-water boiler. With its own kitchen, sleeping area and en-suite facilities, it offers excellent flexibility for use as a granny flat, guest accommodation or, subject to the relevant requirements, potential rental income.

Refurbished by the current owners as their intended forever home, No. 17 reflects the care and attention invested in every stage of its transformation. From the upgraded heating and electrics to the newly refurbished interiors and studio apartment, the property has undergone an extensive programme of improvement, resulting in a beautifully finished home that combines contemporary style with generous and versatile accommodation.

If you are seeking a spacious five-bedroom home with gorgeous interiors, extensive recent upgrades, an adjoining self-contained apartment and the convenience of a location just a short walk from Galway city centre, No. 17 Sandyview Drive deserves your attention.

We would be delighted to hear from you and show you around.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property — Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales.
